name: rollup-invoices
description: baas-analyza's invoice ladder, cut to the two rungs a caller must not be able to write: a rollup ('net_total', the sum of the items' amounts, maintained by Alvo) and a computed field that reads it ('gross_total'). Every rule is the constant true, so a refusal measured here is the write guard's and never a policy's (#342).

invoices.description: An invoice; its totals follow from its items.

net_total.description: The sum of the items' amounts, maintained by Alvo.

gross_total.description: The rollup plus the VAT, computed by the database.
